description: The fixed parts of the shared rule override contract. `fixed` lists the hard floor, the rule ids no `## Rule overrides` section may name, and an entry ending in `.*` fixes every id in that class. `machineCheckedClasses` lists the classes the runner checks itself, which take a `none` row but never a `replace:` row. rule-overrides.md explains the contract, and check-rule-overrides.cjs reads this file.

fixed.rule: Parse failure: the file does not parse in its language
Merge-conflict markers left in a text file
Credential signature: a private-key header or a token in a known format
No hardcoded secrets: credentials come from the environment or a secret store
Input validation: every external input is validated at the boundary
No silent failures: an error reaches the caller or is logged with context
Initialization safety: setup guards against double init, races and partial loads
Resource cleanup: handles, connections, subscriptions and timers close deterministically
Accessibility for UI code: keyboard-operable, an accessible name and a visible focus state
The review severity ids P0, P1 and P2 and what each one means
The review reach rule: a P0 or P1 finding names an input or caller in reach
Review security minimums: auth and authorization gaps, injection exposure, unsafe secrets handling and privilege misuse
Review correctness minimums: regression risk, contract safety, spec mismatch, destructive side effects and boundary handling
